policy.name: HALF_CLEAN_UNMAPPED_LEAF_FILE_V1
policy.formula: credit = floor(max(0, min(current, file, active_file + inactive_file) - file_mapped - file_dirty - file_writeback - shmem - unevictable - max(memory.min, memory.low)) / 2)
policy.bracketing: Use larger before/after usage for cap headroom, smaller before/after usage when computing credit, and the smaller credit of two cache observations.
policy.cap_formula: estimated_available = min(memory.max, max(0, memory.max - charged_current + credit))
policy.overall_formula: min(host MemAvailable, finite ancestor memory limits, every finite ancestor estimated_available)
policy.eligibility: Verified leaf with zero living and dying descendants and complete nonnegative accounting. Otherwise no cache credit.
policy.half_factor_origin: Explicit conservative project policy; not a kernel-defined cgroup MemAvailable formula.

primary_documentation.supports: memory.current includes charged memory; file includes filesystem cache and shared memory; mapped/dirty/writeback/shmem and file-LRU counters have distinct meanings; min/low protections and hierarchical limits apply.
